Privacy Policy for Sorola QR Code Generator

Effective Date: August 2026

1. Introduction

Sorola QR Code Generator ("the Tool") is a free QR code generator committed to protecting user privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how the Tool handles information.

2. Data Collection and Usage

The Tool generates QR codes by sending the user-provided data to a server-side API endpoint (/api/qr-proxy) solely to render the QR code image. This data is processed only to produce the image and is not stored, logged, or used for any other purpose.

  • No Tracking: The Tool does not track your browsing history, monitor your behavior, or collect any analytics.
  • No Personal Data: No personal identification information, accounts, or cookies are collected or stored.
  • No Data Retention: The input data is processed in real-time to generate the QR image and is not saved on the server.

3. Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do not sell, trade, or rent user data to any third parties. The Tool does not contain tracking codes, analytics, or advertisements.

4. Security

All communication with the QR generation endpoint is conducted via secure, encrypted HTTPS protocols. Do not enter sensitive information such as passwords into the QR generator.

5. Contact

If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, you can contact us at: contact.make@sorola.fi
